The phone types and any additional numbers are NEEDS-YOU if the preschool requires them. Enter the preschool’s name and the requested email addresses directly on the form.

## Official-use section

Leave B01–B07 for preschool staff. These are the details to have ready if they ask.

| Blank | Detail |
|---|---|
| B01 — child’s name | GIVEN_P3 SURNAME_P3 |
| B02 — date of birth | DATE_P3 |
| B03 — sex | Mark Female |
| B04 — religion | NEEDS-YOU — child’s religion, if applicable |
| B05 — home address | ADDRESS_P1 |
| B06 — date of full immunization | NEEDS-YOU — date from the child’s health records |
| B07 — admission date | NEEDS-YOU — exact admission date |

For B02, transfer the restored passport date into the day, month, and year boxes in that order. The requested start is January 2027 in Roseau.
